Figures are checked against the selected reporting week and all nine departments. Weekly revenue uses the source week two rail weeks earlier. Applying saves figures for finance review; it does not approve or publish them.

Finance review and publication

Applied workbooks appear here. A finance reviewer must reconcile a validated import, then publish it before its figures appear in department reports and Presenter Mode. Imports with unresolved findings or incomplete figures stay blocked.

Department financial allocation

Figures appear in reports after finance approval. Applying a workbook saves it for finance review but does not publish it. Weekly revenue uses the source week two rail weeks earlier. Missing values show as “Not reported”. Departments can submit reports without finance figures.
